CONSOLIDATED MOCKUP REVIEW RECORD — cand-1NFG8CC1R6Z4H1SJTCC2VYFPRF at exact 34caf555d0b4137d3327c6d8db8783f631d1b653 is BLOCKED by all three required reviewers. This is a successor checklist, not a request to weaken or discard the repairs that passed.

WHAT PASSED. Exact identity and two-root scope are correct. Signed artifact and reproducible digests reconstruct twice; Compact DPR2 recapture is byte-identical; all 15 plates exist; Chronology Loom and Feature scale-space are populated; earlier clipping, collision, compact tick, matrix headings, StateBoard non-colour semantics, motion-rest, blank-band, and dead-tab repairs pass visually apart from the notice below. The 37 claim records and spans, recall-row totals, full eight-way MemoryAddress, chronology contract, and declared 92-observed plus 25-missing feature coverage ledger pass. No script/network resource or Intaglio ontology change was introduced. Browser ownership audits were clean before and after.

IMPLEMENTATION / PROOF REPAIRS. (I1) Preserve and authenticate the exact self-clipping finding: the current self mutation passes only through generic reachability fallback with selfFinding=null. Self and outer-ancestor mutations must reject the opposite diagnosis. (I2) Separate immutable REQUIRED_DPR=2 from capture configuration and observed DPR. A capture-only DPR1 mutant must fail before receipt; renderer prose, observed DPR, and dimensions must agree. (I3) Correct the dda53463 predecessor tree/artifact/repro digests in PIXEL-REVIEW-BASELINE.md and add commit-to-tree plus manifest-to-digest mutation courts. (I4) Add and record real Feature mutations or narrow PROOF-BOUNDARY; it currently claims mutations featureScaleCourt does not perform.

SCIENTIFIC / AUDIT REPAIRS. (S1) Replace stale acceptance-brief Attribute-distorted with canonical Object and bind acceptance vocabulary to the pinned Facet enum. (S2) For reporting-faithful r03 Source(s02), render Context=consistent; its correct table is currently unreachable and the inspector says not applicable. (S3) The Feature plate cannot call 25 stems raw provider observations or show 9w/61w provider windows from a fixture containing no raw values and only one 25-token WindowPlan. Either add a complete token-addressed ledger and declared derivations, or render only the receipted aggregate; any LOD sample needs an explicit deterministic policy. Replace count-only checks with a numerical oracle over values, ordinals, windows, reducer, missingness, coordinates, and coverage.

UX / ACCESSIBILITY REPAIR. (U1) The inert-controls notice is present in DOM but invisible at 1.000:1 on all 15 plates. Give it explicit contrasting styling and add rendered bounds/contrast verification plus an equal-foreground killing mutation.

Exact durable reviews: implementation post-01M19P6X5D6NAZVYT7CK0GY42E; science post-01M19NX8P2YJ6C5ZB27M3EK4HA; UX post-01M19NS4KTSNEE3AD07G1ZGQ0B. Current candidate landability also reports unresolved ancestor/supersession state and no authorization. Chief should not authorize this candidate. Repair owner: please recut one immutable successor retaining all passing repairs and request the same three fresh exact-candidate reviews. No shared-tree edit, staging, authorization, landing, or push was performed by the review team.
